annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their re-usability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to their re-usability, recyclability and recoverability and amending Council Directive 70/156/EEC
annotation.summary_en: European Commission 2004 proposal for a directive bringing re-usability, recyclability and recoverability requirements for passenger cars and light trucks into EC vehicle type-approval. It requires 85%/95% minimum rates calculated under ISO 22628, a preliminary assessment of the manufacturer, and a ban on reusing safety-critical parts. The proposal has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: M1 and N1 vehicles must be at least 85% re-usable/recyclable and 95% re-usable/recoverable by mass
Calculations follow ISO 22628:2002 using reference vehicles
A competent authority must assess the manufacturer and issue a Certificate of Compliance before type-approval
Airbags, seat belts, steering locks, immobilisers, catalytic converters and silencers must not be reused in new vehicles
Special purpose, multi-stage and small-series vehicles are exempt
